changelog:
WHAT'S NEW
• Plex has a new look: the highlighted title big across the top with its year, rating and story, wide Continue Watching pictures, gold highlights, and a cleaner title page
• Live TV channel rows are thinner: about 5 fit on screen instead of 3½, with the same name, show and times
• Multi-Screen: up to 5 screens (one big, four small). Before a screen would take your line over its limit you are warned, and can message the other TVs on the line; by each screen's name, F means the line is full and O means it is over
• Game Day: PPV is back, with UFC, boxing, wrestling and every event on your PPV channels that day; ▲ ▼ now move through the sports
• Live TV Settings → Services: hold OK on a service to delete it from this box
• Recording & Rewind: one tidy page that fits on the screen
• Settings → Media: a slimmer Generate background with AI, and the whole width of the screen used
• Live TV sign-in: Show on the password box lets you see what you typed (also on Add another service and the Vibez sign-in); it is hidden again every time
• Fix: after the remote's Menu (≡) button opened a channel's or a category's menu, the first OK there did nothing
• Add another service: with an active DreamStreams or Vibez line, add one other provider (its Xtream login or M3U link) in Live TV Settings → Services; its Live TV channels show beside yours
• A channel that's down plays from your other service by itself, with a note saying so (Live TV Settings → Channels to turn it off)
• A channel that's off the air now says so in seconds (it used to buffer for minutes), with Report it; channels off the air are marked for everyone on your service until they play again
• Still buffering? A short helper pops up over the picture: restart your box and router, try a VPN, then the Buffering Guide
• Search while you watch: ◀ opens the channel list over the picture, Search channels is at the top, and the channel keeps playing
• The preview box keeps playing what you were watching while you look around; OK plays another channel there, OK again goes full screen
• Slim channel rows: 10 or more channels on screen, each with what's on and when it ends (Live TV Settings → Appearance)
• Favorites in your own order: hold OK or press Menu on a favorite, then Move; or Sort A–Z
• Live TV Settings rearranged: My Account, Services, Channels, Appearance, Recording & rewind, Player, Fix a problem and Sign Out, each showing its setting underneath
• Record to your computer or NAS: Live TV Settings → Recording & rewind → Recordings on a computer. Pick the computer, its shared folder and its sign-in; recordings go there, wait on this box if the computer is off and are copied over later, and play from the Recordings list
• Free trial: a trial that was made but never reached this TV is now handed over, instead of "Trial already used"
• Game Day: a game is never "not in your channels" while your channels are still being searched; it says it is still looking, and "Couldn't check your channels" with Try again when a line didn't load
• Live TV: when the service doesn't send your channel list, it says so and why (instead of an empty list), and tries again by itself; Update Channels only says "Channels updated!" when they really came
• Updates arrive reliably: a new version downloads after 10 seconds on the Home screen (it waited for a full minute), and "Later" now asks again the next day instead of never
• While watching: each ◀ on the remote jumps back 10 s and ▶ jumps forward (Live TV channels, Live TV films and episodes, Plex); quick presses add up
• Live TV: the channel list over the picture is now the remote's Menu (≡) button (◀ still opens it on a channel that can't go back)
• Fix: the remote's Menu (≡) button never reached Snow Media Center on a Fire TV; it now opens the channel list while you watch, and a channel's or a category's menu in the lists
• Live TV Settings → My Account → Devices on this line: see the TVs signed in to your line, which ones are watching now, and send all or some of them a short message that pops up on their screen (a line with no email on file sends it through support)
• Live TV Settings: ◀ goes straight back to the menu from Account info and Playback (it used to move up the list)
• Parent PIN: only asked for once there's a Kids profile; adding the first Kids profile has a grown-up set it
• Parent PIN: a grown-up sets one PIN for the account, and kids can't add a profile or switch to a grown-up's without it (Profiles, or Settings → Profiles)
• Settings → UI: Sign out of player can be reached with the remote (press OK twice)
• Settings, easier with the remote: the choices stand in a column on the left and ▲ ▼ move through them, with the page on the right (the main Settings and Live TV's)
• Live TV Account info: its buttons in a column beside your details, ▲ ▼ to move
• Live TV sign-in: "New customer? Click here to create an account"
• Fix: Sign out of player on the account card no longer signs you straight back in with your store account
• Fix: on a Fire TV, the keyboard on a sign-in screen kept coming back after Back; Back now puts it away, and after the password it lands on Sign in
• Fix: on Android TV boxes like the X96, a solid dark block could cover parts of the screen while the sound played; those boxes now run Snow Media Center the way a Fire TV does
• Fix: on some Android boxes (X96 and others with an older system WebView) Live TV's preview was hidden behind a dark screen; the preview now sizes itself on every box
• Plex: Genre, Year and Rated now list their choices in every library
• Plex: hold OK on a movie or show to recommend it to other viewers; Discover shows what viewers recommend
• Fix: a black screen with the sound still playing. If a channel's picture does not start, the player restarts it by itself, and if it still cannot, it says so with Retry instead of staying black
• Trailers: a Trailer button on movie and show pages in Movies, TV Shows and Plex; it plays inside Snow Media Center, OK pauses and resumes it, Back closes it
• Movies and TV Shows: rest on a category for a second and its titles show beside the list, as Live TV channels do
• Multi-Screen fills the whole screen: the top bar and side menu step aside while your screens play (◀ or ▲ bring them back), and every screen is 16:9 and as large as fits
• Multi-Screen: the buffering tip closes with Back and goes away by itself
• Live TV: the channel list over the picture is more see-through; ◀ opens the channel list, ◀ again the categories
• Watched check marks: a gold check on every film and episode you finished, in Movies, TV Shows and Plex, and on a season once you have watched all of it
• Live TV: while watching, ◀ shows the channel list and ▶ your last 10 channels
• Compact Guide and a compact logo wall: more on screen (Live TV Settings → Appearance)
• Guide: hold OK on a channel for its menu, longer show names, Loading… while info arrives
• Phones and tablets: an upright layout held up, a fitted one turned sideways, everything by touch
• Multi-Screen: a new 3-screen layout, one big screen and two small ones; OK on a small one makes it the big one
• Sharper Plex covers once the screen has loaded
• Smooth 4K: films go straight to the screen with HDR/Dolby Vision, the TV switches to the film's own frame rate, and Dolby/DTS sound goes to your TV or the box's hardware
• Game Day: PPV is back with every event on your PPV channels (PPV1, PPV2, PPV3…), UFC cards find their PPV channels, and smarter channel finding
• Smoother playback on a full Fire TV: apps left running in the background are closed when memory runs low
• Favorites · all services: with DreamStreams and Vibez, all your favorites in one list
• Long subtitle and audio lists scroll instead of running off the screen
• Report a whole category that's down; channels reported buffering now warn you before they play
• Rate Snow Media Center with stars, a written review or a voice review (Settings → UI)
• Keyboard voice typing: the remote's voice key is left to the keyboard while you type
• Tickets and reports now include your line and how many connections are in use
releaseNotes: Version 1.9.6: Plex has a new look, with the highlighted title big across the top, wide Continue Watching pictures and gold highlights. Live TV channel rows are thinner, so about 5 fit on screen. Multi-Screen can show up to 5 screens, warns you before a screen would take your line over its limit (with a way to message the other TVs on the line), and marks a full line F and an over-the-limit line O. Game Day has PPV back with UFC, boxing, wrestling and every event on your PPV channels, and the remote moves up and down through the sports. Hold OK on a service in Live TV Settings → Services to delete it. Recording & Rewind and Settings → Media are slimmer. New in 1.9.5: The Live TV sign-in has a Show button on the password box, so you can check what you typed (also on Add another service and the Vibez sign-in); the password is hidden again every time. Fix: the first OK in a menu opened with the remote's Menu (≡) button now works. New in 1.9.4: With an active DreamStreams or Vibez line you can now add one other provider (its Xtream login or M3U link) in Live TV Settings → Services, and its Live TV channels show beside yours. A channel that's down plays from your other service by itself, a channel that's off the air says so in seconds with Report it, and channels off the air are marked for everyone on your service until they play again. If a channel keeps buffering, a short helper pops up: restart, try a VPN, then the Buffering Guide. While watching, ◀ opens the channel list over the picture with Search channels at the top, and the preview box keeps playing what you were watching while you look around. New slim channel rows fit 10 or more channels on screen (Live TV Settings → Appearance), favorites can be put in your own order or A–Z, and Live TV Settings is rearranged into My Account, Services, Channels, Appearance, Recording & rewind, Player, Fix a problem and Sign Out. Also: record Live TV to a computer or NAS on your home network (Live TV Settings → Recording & rewind → Recordings on a computer): pick the computer, its shared folder and its sign-in, and your recordings go there; if the computer is off they wait on this box and are copied over later. A free trial that was made but never reached your TV is now handed over instead of "Trial already used". Game Day no longer says a game isn't in your channels while it is still looking. New in 1.9.3: When the service doesn't send your channel list, Live TV now says so and why instead of showing an empty list, and Update Channels only says the channels were updated when they really came. Updates now arrive reliably: a new version downloads after 10 seconds on the Home screen, and "Later" asks again the next day instead of never. While watching, each press of ◀ on the remote jumps back 10 seconds and ▶ jumps forward, in Live TV channels, Live TV films and episodes, and Plex; quick presses add up. In Live TV the channel list over the picture is now on the remote's Menu (≡) button (◀ still opens it on a channel that can't go back). New in 1.9.2: New in Live TV Settings: Devices on this line (now under My Account) shows the TVs signed in to your line and which ones are watching now, and lets you send all of them, or the ones you pick, a short message that pops up on their screen ("please switch to the other account"). If the line has no email on file, Snow Media support sends the message for you. In Live TV Settings, left goes straight back to the menu from Account info and Playback. The Parent PIN is only asked for once the account has a Kids profile; adding the first Kids profile has a grown-up set it. New in 1.9.1: New Parent PIN: a grown-up sets one PIN for the account, and kids can't add a profile or switch to a grown-up's profile without it. Settings are easier with the remote: the choices stand in a column on the left, the remote's up and down move through them, and the page shows on the right, in the main Settings and in Live TV's (Account info too). The Live TV sign-in now says "New customer? Click here to create an account". Fix: Sign out of player on the account card no longer signs you straight back in with your store account. New in 1.9.0: On a Fire TV, the keyboard on a sign-in screen no longer keeps coming back after Back. Fixes Android TV boxes like the X96, where a solid dark block could cover the screen or the Live TV preview while the sound played. In Plex, Genre, Year and Rated now list their choices in every library, and you can hold OK on a movie or show to recommend it to other viewers; Discover has a new row of what viewers recommend. New in 1.8.9: Fixes a black screen with the sound still playing on some boxes. If a channel's picture does not start, Snow Media Center now restarts it by itself, and if it still cannot, it says so with a Retry button instead of staying black. New in 1.8.8: Trailers are here. Movies, TV Shows and Plex have a Trailer button on a title's page; the trailer plays inside Snow Media Center, OK pauses and resumes it, and Back closes it. In Movies and TV Shows a category's titles now show once you rest on it for a second, the way Live TV's channels do. Multi-Screen uses the whole screen: the top bar and side menu step aside while your screens play, and every screen is as large as fits. In Live TV, the channel list over the picture is more see-through, and ◀ opens the channel list first, ◀ again the categories. New in 1.8.7: Snow Media Center now marks what you have watched. Movies, TV Shows and Plex put a gold check on every film and episode you finished (stopping at the end credits counts), and on a season once every episode in it is watched. New in 1.8.6: While watching Live TV, ◀ shows the channel list and ▶ your last 10 channels. A new compact Guide and a compact logo wall fit more on screen (Live TV Settings → Appearance). In the Guide, hold OK on a channel for its menu. On phones and tablets Snow Media Center now has an upright layout and a fitted sideways one, all by touch. Also new: Multi-Screen has a new 3-screen layout: one big screen and two small ones under it, and OK on a small one swaps it into the big one. Plex covers turn sharp once the screen has loaded. Also new since 1.8.3: Smoother 4K (films drawn straight to the screen with HDR and Dolby Vision, the TV matched to the film's frame rate, and Dolby/DTS sound sent to your TV or the box's hardware first). Game Day lists every PPV event again, including PPV1/PPV2/PPV3 categories, and UFC cards find their PPV channels. You can report a whole Live TV category that's down, and channels reported for buffering show a warning before they play. When a Fire TV runs low on memory, Snow Media Center closes the apps left in the background so playback stays smooth. With more than one service, Favorites · all services shows every favorite in one list. Long subtitle and audio lists now scroll. New: rate Snow Media Center from Settings → UI. Tickets and reports now carry your line and its connection count, never your password.
